results.english: The meaning of the word bocchi (“alone”) is shifting. Traditionally, as in hitori-bocchi (“all alone”), it carried a negative connotation, describing someone who is alone and lonely. However, it is increasingly taking on a more positive nuance, as seen in expressions like “Bocchi mesi (“solo dining”) is the best!” or “Bocchi sanka (“flying solo”) again today!”, where being alone is framed as something enjoyable rather than sad.
results.kanji: 「ぼっち」という言葉の意味は、従来の「ひとりぼっち」のように一人で寂しい様子を表すネガティブなものから、「ぼっちメシ最高！」「今日もぼっち参加！」のように一人を楽しむというポジティブなニュアンスを含むものに変質しつつある。
